This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Kenobi II" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|purple]] skin. They also had yellow stripes situated horizontally across their faces.<ref name="Kenobi II" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi Date">{{KenobiDate|II}}</ref> a member of this species was present in the [[Daiyu marketplace|marketplace]] within [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] when [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived in search of the kidnapped [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]].<ref name="Kenobi II" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the limited television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']],<ref name="Kenobi II" /> which was released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref>
